scenario: Deliberate HTTP 503 on the fictitious Aurora portal; all treatment steps scripted
knowledge_query: Portal HTTP indisponível erro 503 recuperação sondagens
criteria: Fresh isolated database, no prior operational case for the target
Actual orders HTTP 503 after injection and HTTP 200 after explicit recovery
One new automatic P1 incident per repetition, no duplicate after 12 seconds
Current-run HTTP 503 log preserved in the incident
Previous closed trial found in top five before recovery on trials two and three
Hybrid search must actually use the local semantic model, no fallback
Recovery confirmed by fresh probes before resolution and post-mortem closure
Closed case immutable and retrievable, no active target incident left

timing.clock: Client monotonic elapsed seconds; accompanying UTC wall timestamps
timing.injection: Before fault-control HTTP request; also store response end
timing.detection: First API poll observing the new automatic incident
timing.confirmation: First API poll observing fresh recovery in incident history
timing.poll_uncertainty: Up to one polling interval plus request and scheduling time; not exact internal transition time
timing.scripted_treatment: Assignment/acknowledgement/investigation/closure driven by script; not human MTTA or MTTR

limits: Three identical laboratory failures, no production or independent human baseline
No inference of productivity gains or causal improvement from knowledge retrieval
Detection uses health endpoint; orders endpoint independently verifies visible impact
One host, shared host resources, warm containers and model; startup excluded
Polling and intentional deduplication hold contribute to total case time
